messages:
maria: ACME asked for an upgrade path that preserves customer-assigned egress IPs w/o full reprovision. they want SLA language and a minimal installer change. can we propose a low-risk MVP?

aj: two paths: operator-lite shim (minimal infra changes, preserves bindings) or rolling attach via provider APIs (less magic, more cloud ops work).

luke: operator-shim preferred for zero-ip-change customers. needs installer toggle + preflight check for cloud permissions.

sasha: ACME needs audit trail of eip assignments and a rollback promise if preservation fails. target disruption <1hr.

aj: MVP scope suggestion: 1) installer flag `--preserve-egress` 2) preflight `ri preflight egress-check` 3) egress-preserve controller + telemetry 4) audit export for support.

luke: provider adapters: AWS first (EIP/ENI attach), then GCP, Azure. adapter interface: claim -> bind -> verify -> release.

legal-bot: reminder: include explicit rollback clause and define SLA metrics (time-to-detect, time-to-recover, %ips preserved).

sasha: i'll draft contract addendum + customer comms template. support runbook will include logs to gather and escalation steps.

aj: rough timeline: shim core + tests = 2 sprints, AWS adapter = 1 sprint, docs + pilots = 1 sprint. parallelize adapters after AWS.

maria: launch gates draft: A) preflight pass on AWS; B) integration tests + chaos injection; C) audit/export verified; D) 1 pilot customer; E) runbook & docs published. any fail = hold.

luke: i will prototype AWS adapter and add failure-mode tests (rate limits, attach conflicts).

sasha: booking legal review and pilot comms with ACME. :thumbsup:

maria: next steps: aj opens RFC PR for flag + controller API, luke delivers AWS prototype, sasha drafts contracts/runbook. weekly sync Fri 10am.
